==About==

{{i|Cranberry Sauce}} must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. Eating Cranberry Sauce will return the {{i|Glass Jar}}. Cranberry Sauce is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Berries}} Food Group. Eating Cranberry Sauce will return the {{i|Glass Jar}}.
